quantization: For each MG/EG feature family: integer scale=max(1,ceil(max(abs(w))/7)); code=sign(w)*floor(abs(w)/scale+0.5); reconstructed coefficient=code*scale. No floating-point rounding convention changes.
selection: Full remains mandatory. At most one other candidate may enter fresh game testing: pass all validation guards, then improve optimized WASM whole-search geometric-mean NPS by at least5% against full on the separately frozen cost grid. Choose highest such NPS; ties within0.5% choose lower validation CE, then lexicographic ID. Freeze this choice before any game output.
holdoutPolicy: No v1 holdout or OOD performance is recomputed or used for selection. Existing validation is development data; fresh game outcomes supply independent evidence.
outputPolicy: Freeze configuration, source hashes and all derived model bytes before loading validation; reserve output directory exclusively and write completion last. No refit, adaptive recipe, or selective retry.
